verdict.rationale: Undermind is built specifically for scholarly literature search: it runs deep literature reviews that return ranked papers, follows citations and key authors, and reads full-text PDFs including figures, tables and equations. Hands-on users independently confirm it surfaced papers they had missed in Google Scholar, arXiv and ScienceDirect. Missing for 10: no documented list of which corpora or databases it covers, and weak coverage of gray literature and dissertations/theses as primary sources (users report missing these).
